Reference implementation (Python 3.12+):
```python
def rotate_right(values, k):
    n = len(values)
    if not n: return values
    k %= n
    def reverse(left, right):
        while left < right:
            values[left], values[right] = values[right], values[left]
            left += 1; right -= 1
    reverse(0, n - 1); reverse(0, k - 1); reverse(k, n - 1)
    return values

assert rotate_right([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 2) == [4, 5, 1, 2, 3]
```
explanation: Three reversals rotate right by k; reduce k modulo n and handle an empty list. Time O(n), auxiliary space O(1).
